snippet.title: [The Apothecary Diaries Palace Chronicles] Teaser PV Now Live!
snippet.description:
The Apothecary Diaries Palace Chronicles is the first simulation game based on the anime The Apothecary Diaries. Take on the challenge of solving various cases and requests occurring in the Imperial Court and the pleasure district.

Pre-registration is now open!

■ Pre-register here: 
1. Register via official WhatsApp: https://api.whatsapp.com/send/?phone=85244550144&text=I%20want%20to%20pre-register
2. Follow the official X (formerly Twitter): https://x.com/kusuriya_ki_en
3. Follow the official IG: https://www.instagram.com/kusuriya_ki_en
4. Official Discord: https://discord.gg/cYxCUr9jN6
5. Visit the official website: https://s.g123.jp/ymn56o3w

■Basic Info
Game title: The Apothecary Diaries Palace Chronicles
Genre: Simulation
Price: Free (with in-game purchases)
